name: igus iggyRob
summary: A low-cost German wheeled humanoid: two ReBeL cobot arms (2 kg each) with a gripper and a suction gripper on a ReBeLMove Pro AMR, for light parts transport and reception tasks indoors.

germany.statusNote: Listed in the igus.de online shop with price and cart button ("zzgl. MwSt. und Versand"); delivery time shown as "Lieferzeit auf Anfrage" (on request). CE certified. Made by igus in Cologne.
